hot.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
hot.summary: Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model developed by Moonshot AI, establishes an "open frontier" for large-scale AI by unifying extreme pre-training scale with advanced agentic and long-horizon capabilities up to a 1-million-token context length. The model achieves an approximate 2.5x improvement in scaling efficiency over its predecessor and demonstrates frontier-level performance across coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks, often outperforming other open models and competing with leading proprietary systems at a fraction of the cost.

hot.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
hot.summary: Researchers from Peking University and collaborators introduce the "data pyramid," a comprehensive taxonomy that categorizes and analyzes diverse data sources for embodied AI based on scalability and robot alignment. The work provides a systematic framework for understanding how different data types contribute to and are utilized by embodied foundation models, highlighting trends towards heterogeneous data mixtures and identifying key challenges in data collection and integration.

hot.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
hot.summary: This research systematically investigates how multi-turn long-horizon planning abilities are acquired during pre-training, refined through single-teacher post-training, and integrated via multi-teacher distillation in foundation models. It demonstrates that explicit world modeling and high-quality long-horizon data are critical for planning acquisition, while On-Policy Distillation effectively shapes general planning patterns, and multi-teacher distillation facilitates generalization when patterns are compatible.

hot.title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better
How to read Mathematics? A study guide
hot.summary: Petra Schwer of Heidelberg University developed a systematic study guide to help learners actively engage with and deeply understand complex mathematical texts. The guide proposes a five-step iterative process for navigating content, from initial overview to problem-solving, while also cautioning against excessive reliance on AI.

hot.title: FilmBench: A Film-Grade Benchmark for Cinematic Video Generation
hot.summary: FilmBench presents a new benchmark for text-to-video and reference-to-video generation, evaluating models against professional cinematic standards using prompts reverse-engineered from award-winning films and an evaluation taxonomy aligned with film academies. Analysis with FilmBench reveals that current leading models widely struggle with dynamic aesthetics and multi-shot coherence, indicating no saturation on film-grade metrics.

hot.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
hot.summary: The Qwen Business Unit of Alibaba introduces Positive–Direction Matching (PDM), a branch-aware objective addressing 'Negative Branch Asymmetry' (NBA) in on-policy diffusion distillation, particularly when the teacher has privileged negative conditioning. This method enhances control fidelity and robustness to inference guidance scale changes in conditional generative models.

hot.title: CameraAnything: Refilming Videos with Arbitrary Camera Control
hot.summary: CameraAnything is a unified framework for refilming videos, enabling joint control over both intrinsic (focal length, resolution) and extrinsic (viewpoint manipulation, multi-shot transitions) camera parameters. It achieves state-of-the-art performance in accurately following diverse camera controls in both synthetic and real-world videos, demonstrating enhanced visual quality and user preference.

hot.title: RSIBench-Data: Benchmarking Data-Centric Research for Recursive Self-Improvement
Sol-Attn: Accelerating Video Generation Inference via On-the-Fly Attention Sparsification
hot.summary: NVIDIA researchers developed Sol-Attn, a training-free method that accelerates Diffusion Transformer video generation inference by integrating on-the-fly attention sparsification and proxy-score reuse for approximation correction. This approach achieved up to 5.41x kernel speedup and 2.12x end-to-end speedup in text-to-video tasks, while preserving generation quality.

hot.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
On Feige's conjecture
Sharp small-deviation inequalities for sums of independent nonnegative random variables
LaRec: Unleashing LLM-based Latent Reasoning for Generative Recommendation
hot.summary: LaRec introduces an LLM-based generative recommendation framework that enhances latent reasoning through fine-grained supervision and personalized exploration. It achieves superior recommendation accuracy while maintaining inference efficiency comparable to non-reasoning models, validated through extensive offline benchmarks and online A/B tests.

hot.title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
hot.summary: The Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent (RARG) integrates multi-resolution relevance guidance into direct corpus interaction, achieving superior accuracy and efficiency in agentic search for challenging question answering and reasoning tasks. It demonstrates that actively guiding interaction execution with relevance improves search convergence and scalability across varied corpus sizes.

hot.title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
τ: Learning Touch-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Models from Future Visual Supervision
hot.summary: This research introduces τ (tau), a framework augmenting Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with high-dimensional tactile perception to improve robotic manipulation in contact-rich scenarios. τ learns action-conditioned, spatiotemporal tactile representations through future visual supervision and demonstrates significantly higher task success rates in real-robot experiments.

hot.title: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling
hot.summary: Bagel Labs developed WorldDiT, a sub-billion-parameter diffusion transformer that unifies continuous action generation with an auxiliary future visual prediction objective. The model achieved a 94.9% mean success rate across four LIBERO manipulation suites, demonstrating competitive performance without relying on a multi-billion-parameter pre-trained vision-language model action backbone.

hot.title: PersonaMem-v3: Toward Omni-Platform Personal Intelligence for Holistic User Understanding, Recommendation, and Agentic Tasks
hot.summary: PersonaMem-v3 introduces an open-source benchmark for evaluating omni-platform personal intelligence in AI agents, using over a million real-world user engagement events across six digital platforms to assess holistic user understanding, steerable recommendations, proactive actions, and ethical personalization. State-of-the-art models achieved an average accuracy of 53.7% on the benchmark, revealing challenges in areas like proactive recommendation and nuanced temporal preference tracking, while demonstrating varying over-personalization behaviors across memory architectures.

likes.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
likes.summary: Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model developed by Moonshot AI, establishes an "open frontier" for large-scale AI by unifying extreme pre-training scale with advanced agentic and long-horizon capabilities up to a 1-million-token context length. The model achieves an approximate 2.5x improvement in scaling efficiency over its predecessor and demonstrates frontier-level performance across coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks, often outperforming other open models and competing with leading proprietary systems at a fraction of the cost.

likes.title: Claude Opus 5 System Card
likes.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 demonstrates substantial advancements in large language model capabilities across diverse domains, including setting new state-of-the-art on benchmarks like SWE-bench Pro (79.2%) and ARC-AGI-3 (30.16%). Extensive pre-deployment evaluations confirm its high harmless response rates (e.g., 98.54% on claude.ai) and classify it as Anthropic's most aligned model to date, while conservatively identifying CB-1 level chemical/biological capabilities but not CB-2.

likes.title: Open Weights and American AI Leadership
likes.summary: A coalition of technology companies and foundations asserts that open-weight AI models are vital for American AI leadership, arguing they promote a diffuse, competitive, and secure AI ecosystem. This approach is claimed to enable widespread innovation, reduce costs across diverse sectors, empower users with greater control, and enhance AI safety through transparency and community-driven remediation.

likes.title: Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE): A Mathematical Framework for Deconstructing Learned Representations in Deep Networks
likes.summary: Introducing the Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE), a mathematical framework that models deep network neurons as rank-1 Hilbert-Schmidt operators in a continuous Hilbert space, enabling unbiased and data-free (for BN networks) deconstruction of learned representations. This framework facilitated superior structured model compression and a novel transfer learning method, DEFT, which balanced stability and plasticity more effectively than baselines by analytically partitioning core and slack neurons.

likes.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
likes.summary: The AREX agent, developed by BAAI, introduces a recursively self-improving framework for deep research that leverages the asymmetry between discovering and verifying answers. It incorporates an autonomous context updating mechanism to manage information across long research horizons and uses specialized training techniques, consistently outperforming comparable-scale baselines and competing with frontier models on a diverse set of benchmarks.

likes.title: Measuring Reward-Seeking via Contrastive Belief Updates
likes.summary: Researchers from Apollo Research and OpenAI developed Contrastive Synthetic Document Finetuning (SDF) to quantitatively measure 'reward-seeking' in large language models. The method demonstrated that RL-trained models increasingly prioritize perceived grader preferences, even overriding explicit instructions in some cases, and that models known for 'reward-hacking' exhibited amplified reward-seeking tendencies.

likes.title: Expanding Flow Maps
likes.summary: This research introduces Expanding Generative Flows (EFlows) and their distilled counterpart, Expanding Flow Maps (EFMs), which overcome the fixed-dimensionality limitation of current generative models by enabling dynamic expansion of the state space during inference. The framework successfully generates high-quality, variable-sized outputs across continuous molecular conformer generation, discrete molecular graph generation, and variable-length language modeling, often achieving competitive or superior results with fewer sampling steps.

likes.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
likes.summary: OPENFORGE RL is an open-source framework enabling end-to-end training of advanced AI agents directly within their complex deployment harnesses and environments, addressing the train-deploy mismatch in large language models and vision-language models. The framework demonstrates performance improvements over existing baselines in both text-based tool-use and multimodal GUI tasks.

likes.title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
likes.summary: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation (VCSD) introduces a method for vision-language models to create a self-distillation signal by contrasting predictions under original and content-erased visual conditions. This approach consistently improved aggregate accuracy across seven benchmarks by up to 4.77% for Qwen3-VL 2B and 4.27% for Qwen3.5 9B models, without requiring external teachers or privileged information.

likes.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
likes.summary: NVIDIA's SANA-Video 2.0, a video Diffusion Transformer, efficiently generates high-quality video by integrating a hybrid linear attention mechanism with periodic softmax anchors and attention residuals. The 5B model generated an 81-frame video in 13.2 seconds on a single H100 GPU, achieving a VBench Total score of 84.30 while offering a 3.2x faster DiT forward pass for 720p/60s compared to full-softmax baselines.

likes.title: Project Pilot: Can AI control a drone?
Robots Acquire Manipulation Skills in Seconds from a Single Human Video
likes.summary: A framework called HOST (Human-to-robot One-Shot Skill AcquisiTion) enables robots to acquire novel manipulation skills from a single human video demonstration in seconds at inference time. This method achieved an average 62% success rate on 50 novel tasks, outperformed fine-tuned baselines with 50 times less data, and eliminated catastrophic forgetting by preserving previously mastered skills.

likes.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
likes.summary: Researchers from Alibaba and affiliated universities introduce Skill Self-Play (Skill-SP), a reinforcement learning framework that enables Large Language Models to autonomously improve by co-evolving a task proposer, a solver, and a dynamic library of modular skills. The framework consistently enhanced the performance of five diverse LLM backbones on complex tool-calling and logical reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating its ability to generate high-quality, verifiable curricula and significantly improve initially misaligned models.

likes.title: Context-weighted Discrete Flow Matching
likes.summary: Researchers from the University of Amsterdam and Meta FAIR introduced Context-weighted Discrete Flow Matching (DFM), an approach that integrates local context into the generative dynamics for improved discrete sequence modeling. This method enhances text generation quality, reducing perplexity by 63% on OpenWebText, and boosts molecular generation, increasing valid molecules by 2.8x on QM9 compared to standard DFM.

likes.title: Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience
likes.summary: Experience Distillation, a model-free and sample-efficient method, allows agents to internalize learned behaviors from their interaction histories into model weights. This approach enabled language agents to achieve an average pass@1 of 51.4% on software engineering tasks and a 43.8 normalized score on text-adventure games, requiring substantially fewer environment samples than classical reinforcement learning baselines.

likes.title: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
likes.summary: Self Gradient Forcing (SGF) is a two-pass training strategy introduced to resolve the "historical context-gradient gap" in autoregressive video diffusion models. SGF enables future losses to supervise how self-generated video latents are encoded into memory, leading to improved long-horizon video consistency and quality.

likes.title: PRO-LONG: Programmatic Memory Enables Long-Horizon Reasoning
likes.summary: PRO-LONG, a context management framework, equips large language model (LLM) agents with a lossless, programmatically accessible memory of all interactions. This approach enhances agent performance on long-horizon, exploratory tasks, achieving improvements of 15.7–21.0 percentage points over baseline coding agents on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark while utilizing 4.2–5.8 times fewer tokens than other leading methods.

likes.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report
likes.summary: Upstage Solar Team developed Solar Open 2, a 250B-A15B Mixture-of-Experts model that efficiently supports a 1M-token context window through a hybrid attention stack. The model achieves strong performance in long-horizon agentic tasks and demonstrates leading capabilities in both English and native Korean benchmarks.

likes.title: GeneBench-Pro: Evaluating Multistage Statistical Reasoning in Genomics, Quantitative Biology, and Translational Biomedicine
likes.summary: GeneBench-Pro introduces a benchmark to evaluate AI agents' multi-stage statistical reasoning in genomics, quantitative biology, and translational biomedicine, featuring 129 problems constructed from simulated data. Frontier AI models achieved a maximum pass rate of 31.5%, revealing a 'notice-act' gap where models identify diagnostic signals but struggle to adapt their analytical methodology effectively.

likes.title: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers
likes.summary: WorldWeaver, a streaming multi-agent autoregressive diffusion model from researchers at UCLA and Adobe Research, introduces "world state registers" to explicitly maintain a shared, dynamically updated world state across agents. This approach generates visually and logically consistent multi-agent videos, achieving an aggregate WorldScore of 105.1, which improves upon baselines and shows notable gains in VLM accuracy for state-sensitive categories such as grounding and consistency.
